title: region.start
description: Several games (MULTI_GAME_PLAN §4.3, MG2): start this game from its title screen: CONTINUE when the active slot has a save, else NEW GAME, driven through the title menu as the save-slot switch rebuilds it. The intro then runs as ordinary UI (ui.open text boxes, the naming screen, the mirror for graphics). Answered by act.result{kind:"start", detail:"new"|"continue"}; refusals not_title, busy, failed.
